# Spinal cord test fixtures

Synthetic mini atlas and parity references for unit tests. Generated by
`tests/fixtures/spinal_cord/build_fixtures.py` (run once if files are missing).

## Layout

- `atlas/` — mini Fiederling-style atlas (Template.tif, Annotation.tif, CSV tables)
- `sample/` — synthetic cord TIFF stack (channelperfile)
- `parity/align_out_reference.json` — expected straightening optimizer output for regression tests
